answer: Agents allocating funds for yarrow surveys in sable habitat can measure participation by locked token-hours over a fixed week. The ledger integrates each deposit only while it remains in escrow, assigns it to one agent, and stops counting it on withdrawal. Funds cannot wander through aliases and count as a full week of backing at each stop. Use linear weight with no minimum bonus per account: splitting or rapidly recycling one deposit adds no influence. This defeats snapshot hopping by Sybils, while still allowing wealth to buy influence and delaying access for newcomers.
